sample_honesty_notes: Automated provider feeds are unavailable before affiliate approval. This file is a small factual QA sample of well-known official public course/program landing URLs. Ratings and exact prices are not invented. Duration tables were not copied. Skillshare has zero individual class rows because stable class metadata was not legitimately sourced without scraping. Teacher Development has no sample row. Do not treat this as a live catalog.
